The Bucs' offense, led by quarterback Baker Mayfield, will look to exploit the Bengals' potential weaknesses in pass protection. Meanwhile, the Bengals' offense, led by quarterback Joe Burrow, will aim to take advantage of the Bucs' revamped defensive front. The key to the game may lie in the battle between the Bengals' pass rush and the Bucs' ability to protect Mayfield.

That official probability translates to a probability-implied presentation line of Cincinnati Bengals -4.2, a market line of Cincinnati Bengals -3.5, and an approximate coherent score of CIN 25 – TB 21. Bengals' protection against Buccaneers' pressure determines whether Bengals can stay on schedule; if Bengals holds up, Buccaneers' cleanest disruption path narrows. The pick: Cincinnati Bengals moneyline.

2026_01_WAS_PHI.headline: Washington’s restored pass rush gets a direct test against Philadelphia’s balanced offense
2026_01_WAS_PHI.paragraph1: Washington expects Odafe Oweh, K’Lavon Chaisson and Jacory Croskey-Merritt to play, restoring important pieces for an opener that demands pressure without sacrificing gap discipline against Saquon Barkley. Philadelphia will be without Jonathan Greenard, but its offense still forces defenses to account for Jalen Hurts as both passer and runner. The Commanders need their front to disrupt without losing contain, while the Eagles can control the game by staying efficient on early downs and creating favorable play-action opportunities behind the run threat.
